claim: The Control Tower guides say mandatory controls are always applied and can't be changed or deactivated, because they protect Control Tower resources, while elective and strongly recommended controls can be changed at any time; starting with landing zone version 4.0, mandatory controls are no longer applied by default.

qualifiers.condition: starting with landing zone version 4.0, mandatory controls are no longer applied by default

evidence.quote: You can change the elective or strongly recommended controls that are in force, at any time, from the AWS Control Tower console or the AWS Control Tower APIs. Mandatory controls are always applied, and they can't be changed.
These controls are applied to your OUs by default when you set up your landing zone, and they can't be deactivated, because they protect AWS Control Tower resources.
Starting with AWS Control Tower Landing Zone version 4.0, mandatory controls are no longer applied by default.
